map.冬季续航为什么掉这么多？: Why does winter range drop so much?
map.低温下电池内阻升高、可用容量下降，同时座舱制热（尤其 PTC）功耗很大；两者叠加: At low temperature battery internal resistance rises and usable capacity falls, while cabin heating (especially PTC) draws significant power; together they raise actual consumption by about 30%, which is the main cause of winter range loss, so preheat in advance and plan by charging intervals.
